scripts.infra:up: docker compose -p ira_preregist_dev -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.infra:worker: docker compose -p ira_preregist_dev -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build -d worker
scripts.build: npm --workspace app/web run build && npm --workspace app/server run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace app/web run lint && npm --workspace app/server run lint
scripts.test: npm --workspace app/web run test && npm --workspace app/server run test
